title: Kornerstone Devices
content: Kornerstone Devices has licensed the HigHNooN CT Guided Needle Navigation Technology/Patent to vTitan Corporation. Kornerstone is the owner of the patent and has licensed it to vTitan for the purpose of further product enhancement, manufacturing the product, getting the regulatory approvals, testing & marketing/sales. This license agreement is valid for the entire duration of the patent validity and is applicable worldwide. Congratulations on the Strategic Partnership!

title: ZASTI
content: ZASTI AI has won the prestigious MICCAI AI Challenge on “Pancreatic Cancer Survival Prediction”. The AI platform was used to predict cancer survival using CT Scans and other image inputs. Read more about ICCAI: http://www.miccai.org/ Read more about the Competition: http://miccai.cloudapp.net/competitions/84#learn_the_details-overview
